lte1 source:
0  ;;; ELMO TEST: source via lte1
   chain=prerouting action=mark-routing new-routing-mark=to-lte1 passthrough=no
   src-address=192.168.101.201 dst-address-type=!local in-interface-list=LAN
lte2 source:
1  ;;; ELMO TEST: source via lte2
   chain=prerouting action=mark-routing new-routing-mark=to-lte2 passthrough=no
   src-address=192.168.101.202 dst-address-type=!local in-interface-list=LAN
video lte1:
2  ;;; ELMO: video via lte1
   chain=prerouting action=mark-routing new-routing-mark=to-lte1 passthrough=no
   protocol=udp dst-address-type=!local in-interface-list=LAN
   dst-port=5001-5020
video lte2:
3  ;;; ELMO: video via lte2
   chain=prerouting action=mark-routing new-routing-mark=to-lte2 passthrough=no
   protocol=udp dst-address-type=!local in-interface-list=LAN
   dst-port=5021-5040
tables:
Flags: D - DYNAMIC
0  D name="main" fib
 
1    name="to-lte1" fib
 
2    name="to-lte2" fib
routes:
Flags: D - DYNAMIC; A - ACTIVE; c - CONNECT, s - STATIC
0   As ;;; ELMO: main primary lte1
       dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 routing-table=main gateway=lte1 immediate-gw=lte1
       distance=10 scope=30 target-scope=10
 
1    s ;;; ELMO: main backup lte2
       dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 routing-table=main gateway=lte2 immediate-gw=lte2
       distance=20 scope=30 target-scope=10
 
   DAc dst-address=10.66.215.189/32 routing-table=main gateway=lte1
       immediate-gw=lte1 distance=0 scope=10 target-scope=5
       local-address=10.66.215.189%lte1
 
   DAc dst-address=10.210.169.159/32 routing-table=main gateway=lte2
       immediate-gw=lte2 distance=0 scope=10 target-scope=5
       local-address=10.210.169.159%lte2
 
   DAc dst-address=192.168.101.0/24 routing-table=main gateway=bridge1
       immediate-gw=bridge1 distance=0 scope=10 target-scope=5
       local-address=192.168.101.254%bridge1
 
2   As ;;; ELMO: lte1 video route
       dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 routing-table=to-lte1 gateway=lte1
       immediate-gw=lte1 distance=1 scope=30 target-scope=10
 
3    s ;;; ELMO: lte1 video blackhole
       dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 routing-table=to-lte1 blackhole immediate-gw=""
       distance=254
 
4   As ;;; ELMO: lte2 video route
       dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 routing-table=to-lte2 gateway=lte2
       immediate-gw=lte2 distance=1 scope=30 target-scope=10
 
5    s ;;; ELMO: lte2 video blackhole
       dst-address=0.0.0.0/0 routing-table=to-lte2 blackhole immediate-gw=""
       distance=254
nat:
0  ;;; ELMO: masquerade lte1
   chain=srcnat action=masquerade out-interface=lte1
 
1  ;;; ELMO: masquerade lte2
   chain=srcnat action=masquerade out-interface=lte2
